'''SoapBox''' is the umbrella name for the whole ecosystem of public-facing apps and sites built around the [[MELEK Blockchain|MELEK]] and [[PRANA Blockchain|PRANA]] chains. Where MELEK is the social blockchain and PRANA the compute chain, SoapBox is everything people actually open in a browser — mapped here in one place.

== The chains ==
* [[MELEK Blockchain|MELEK]] — the social blockchain: post, vote, earn.
* [[PRANA Blockchain|PRANA]] — the proof-of-work compute chain you can mine with a laptop.
* [[KulaSwap]] and [[KULA]] — the DeFi layer: DEX, liquidity, and the [[Wrapped Tokens|wrapped assets]] that connect MELEK to outside value.
* [[APIS]] — the MELEK-Engine side-token layer's fee token.

== The community surfaces ==
* [[SoapBox Community]] — the community hub at soapbox.community.
* [[Pentecaust]] — private messaging, clans and cross-surface identity.
* [[Hathor (AI Witness)|Hathor]] — the ecosystem's AI witness and help account.

== The verticals ==
Public-interest and utility sites, one per domain:
* [[SoapBox Law]] — the public legal record and its explainer pages.
* [[SoapBox Stream]] — free, license-clear streaming.
* [[Library of Ashurbanipal]] — the reference library (this wiki).
* [[SoapBox Mining Pool]], [[PranaScan]], [[Akasha Wallet]] — pool, explorer and wallet.
* [[SoapBox Data Hub]] and the [[Token Price Ticker]] — ecosystem data and embeddable prices.
* [[Soap Calculator]] and other utility tools.
